text: 20岁的妹子有福了，40岁的男人们点名喜欢你们哦！
en: 20-year-old girls are in luck; the 40-year-old men have singled you out as their favourites!

text: 我享不了这福气，我克夫，谁和我结婚会暴毙。
en: I can't enjoy such fortune — I bring bad luck to my husband; whoever marries me will drop dead.

text: 我自己动手让其暴毙的那种。
en: The sort where I make them drop dead myself.

text: 我们这群40岁的女人还是老实找精子自己当单亲妈妈吧，我们虽然克夫但是我们旺娃呀。
en: We 40-year-old women should just honestly find sperm and become single mothers ourselves; though we bring bad luck to husbands, we bring good fortune to our children!

text: 健身保养备孕中。
en: Working out, looking after myself, preparing to conceive.

text: 哦，精子必须挑20出头的小伙子的啊。
en: Oh, the sperm must be from lads just over 20, you know.

text: 我们只需要一点点精子而已，还是用钱买，国内不行还可以国外混血。
en: We only need a tiny bit of sperm, and we pay for it; if it doesn't work domestically we can go abroad for mixed-race children.

text: 不参与当下任何男女较劲。
en: Not taking part in any of the current man-versus-woman rivalry.

text: 你看我们大龄剩女多好，独美！
en: Look how good we older single women have it — beautiful all on our own!

text: 静静吃瓜看你们男女对峙。
en: Quietly watching the drama as you men and women square off.

text: 毕竟男女洪水滔天和我们有屁关系。
en: After all, a flood between men and women has bugger all to do with us.

text: 为什么有钱人普遍不考虑花100万买一辆12年的乐驰？
en: Why do rich people generally not consider spending 1 million on a 12-year-old Lechi?

text: 如果只看背影
en: If you only look at the silhouette,

text: 好不夸张的说，哪天我要是成功了，丈母娘比我大的我都不看
en: Without exaggeration, if I ever make it big, I won't even consider a mother-in-law older than myself.

text: 因为女的扣啊，不给男生花钱啊。
en: Because women are stingy — they won't spend money on men.

text: 我身边40男的找20多女生，真舍得花钱，基本结婚后女的都是家庭妇女不上班了。
en: The 40-year-old men around me who go for 20-something girls really aren't stingy with money; basically, once married, the women all become housewives and stop working.

text: 也有几个30多女生，成功找到了比自己小的男朋友，最多的差12岁。
en: There are also a few 30-something girls who've successfully found boyfriends younger than themselves, the biggest gap being 12 years.

text: 然后处了一段时间，觉得小男朋友不上进，天天就知道玩。
en: Then after dating for a while, they felt the younger boyfriends weren't ambitious, just wanted to play every day.

text: 多加一句，我认识的，过了38还没结婚的女的，不仅不会结婚，连男朋友也基本不会有了。
en: To add one more thing: the women I know who haven't married past 38 will not only never marry, they basically won't even have boyfriends.

text: 男的或者离异女性反倒没这个问题。
en: Men, or divorced women, on the contrary don't have this problem.

text: 很多商场的男卫生间是40多岁的大姐在打扫。
en: In many shopping centres, it's women in their forties who clean the men's restrooms.

text: 社会已经不把她们当女人看待了。
en: Society no longer treats them as women.

text: 40岁男就该找20岁嫩妹
en: A 40-year-old man should find a tender 20-year-old girl.

text: 40岁女就该找20岁帅哥
en: A 40-year-old woman should find a handsome 20-year-old lad.

text: 错峰竞争，不要让他们相遇，老登们一起瓜分这群可口小鲜肉(✧∇✧)
en: Stagger the competition; don't let them meet — the old geezers divvy up this delectable pack of young hunks (✧∇✧)

text: 我疯啦有好的不选
en: Have I gone mad, not to pick the good ones?
40 years old?

text: 说难听点，你化妆
en: To put it bluntly, you wear makeup,

text: 走在路上都没几个正眼看你的
en: and walking down the street, barely anyone gives you a proper look.

text: 不要说夫妻生活了
en: Never mind married life.

text: 40岁女相比25岁女，要求只多不少，那为啥不找个年轻的?
en: A 40-year-old woman, compared with a 25-year-old woman, has only more, not fewer, demands — so why not find a younger one?

text: 根据我国的社会经验，40岁男只考虑18-25之间的女。
en: According to our country's social experience, 40-year-old men only consider women between 18 and 25.

text: 而40女只能考虑25以下及50以上男。
en: Whereas 40-year-old women can only consider men under 25 and over 50.

text: 两者完全没有交集。
en: The two have absolutely no overlap.

text: 关注我的公众号有惊喜：
en: Follow my public account for a surprise:

text: “40岁男普遍不考虑40岁女”这一说法可能并不完全准确，因为它基于一种普遍性的假设，而实际上人们的感情和择偶选择是复杂多样的。
en: The claim that "40-year-old men generally don't consider 40-year-old women" may not be entirely accurate, because it is based on a general assumption, whereas in reality people's feelings and mate-selection choices are complex and varied.

text: 然而，确实存在一些可能的原因或观念，导致一些人可能持有这样的看法：
en: However, there are indeed some possible reasons or notions that may lead some people to hold such a view:

text: 社会观念影响：在某些社会文化中，男性往往被期望寻找比自己年轻的女性作为伴侣。
en: Influence of social conceptions: in certain social cultures, men are often expected to seek younger women as partners.

text: 这种观念可能源于传统的性别角色和期望，认为男性应该具有更多的“魅力”和“活力”，而年轻的女性则更能体现这些特质。
en: This notion may stem from traditional gender roles and expectations, holding that men should possess more 'charm' and 'vitality', and that younger women better embody these traits.

text: 生育因素：虽然现代医疗技术使得高龄生育成为可能，但一些男性可能仍然担心与同龄女性结婚会影响生育能力。
en: Fertility factors: although modern medical technology makes advanced-age childbirth possible, some men may still worry that marrying a peer woman will affect fertility.

text: 他们可能更倾向于选择年轻的女性，以确保更高的生育成功率。
en: They may prefer to choose younger women to ensure a higher rate of reproductive success.

text: 个人喜好和兴趣：人们的喜好和兴趣各不相同，有些男性可能更喜欢与年轻的女性交往，因为他们觉得年轻女性更有趣、更有活力。
en: Personal preferences and interests: people's likes and interests vary; some men may prefer to associate with younger women because they find them more interesting and energetic.

text: 这并不一定意味着他们不喜欢或不尊重同龄女性，只是个人喜好的问题。
en: This does not necessarily mean they dislike or disrespect peer women; it is merely a matter of personal preference.

text: 经济因素：在一些情况下，男性可能认为与年轻女性结婚能够减轻经济压力。
en: Economic factors: in some cases, men may believe marrying a younger woman can ease financial pressure.

text: 年轻女性可能更有可能没有自己的财产或债务，从而在经济上更为轻松。
en: Younger women are more likely to have no property or debt of their own, and are thus more financially relaxed.

text: 自我价值感：有些人可能将自己的年龄与价值感联系起来，认为年龄越大，价值感就越低。
en: Sense of self-worth: some people may link their age to their sense of worth, believing the older they are, the lower their sense of value.

text: 这种观念可能导致一些男性在寻找伴侣时避免选择同龄女性，以免被认为是在“降低标准”。
en: This notion may lead some men, when seeking a partner, to avoid choosing peer women, for fear of being seen as 'lowering their standards'.

text: 然而，需要强调的是，这些原因或观念并不是普遍适用的，也不应该成为评判他人感情选择的唯一标准。
en: However, it must be emphasised that these reasons or notions are not universally applicable, nor should they become the sole criterion for judging others' romantic choices.

text: 每个人的感情和择偶选择都是独特的，应该受到尊重和理解。
en: Everyone's romantic and mate-selection choices are unique and should be respected and understood.

text: 在寻找伴侣时，最重要的是找到与自己相互尊重、相互支持的人，而不是仅仅基于年龄或其他表面因素做出决定。
en: When seeking a partner, the most important thing is to find someone who respects and supports you mutually, rather than making a decision based merely on age or other superficial factors.

text: 从年龄上看。
en: From the perspective of age.

text: 40岁的男性，事业有成，收入稳定，逐渐走进了人生的巅峰期。
en: A 40-year-old man has a successful career and stable income, gradually entering the peak period of his life.

text: 而40岁的女性，通常正是黄金时期，事业、家庭双丰收。
en: A 40-year-old woman, by contrast, is usually in her golden period, reaping a double harvest in career and family.

text: 在这样的年龄差距下，双方对于人生的认识和期望往往存在一定的差异。
en: Under such an age gap, the two sides' understanding of and expectations for life often differ to some extent.

text: 40岁的男性通常更注重事业的发展，追求的是在事业和家庭之间寻求一个平衡点；而40岁的女性则更注重家庭和谐，在事业和孩子之间寻求一个平衡点。
en: The 40-year-old man usually pays more attention to career development, seeking a balance between career and family; whereas the 40-year-old woman focuses more on family harmony, seeking a balance between career and children.

text: 从生活层面来看。
en: Viewed from the level of daily life.

text: 40岁的男性通常已经有了较为丰富的人生经历，他们更加自信、稳定，在感情中通常占据主导地位。
en: The 40-year-old man usually has fairly rich life experience; he is more confident and stable, and typically occupies the dominant position in relationships.

text: 而40岁的女性，面对事业、家庭的压力，更注重寻找一个陪伴自己走到最后的人。
en: The 40-year-old woman, facing the pressure of career and family, focuses more on finding someone to accompany her to the end.

text: 彼此在价值观和生活态度上存在一定差异，让40岁的男性对40岁的女性缺乏兴趣。
en: The two sides' differences in values and attitude to life leave the 40-year-old man lacking interest in the 40-year-old woman.

text: 从情感投入的角度看。
en: From the angle of emotional investment.

text: 在一段感情中，双方投入的情感和时间是成正比的。
en: In a relationship, the emotion and time invested by both sides are directly proportional.

text: 40岁的男性通常已经度过了青春年华，更加珍惜稳定的感情。
en: The 40-year-old man has usually passed his youthful years and more highly treasures stable affection.

text: 而40岁的女性，通常已经有了较丰富的感情经历，更注重寻找一个能够陪伴自己走到最后的人。
en: The 40-year-old woman, usually having fairly rich romantic experience, focuses more on finding someone who can accompany her to the end.

text: 在这样的心态下，40岁的男性往往会觉得40岁的女性过于成熟，难以投入足够的情感。
en: With such a mindset, the 40-year-old man often feels the 40-year-old woman is overly mature and hard to invest enough emotion in.

text: 从现实压力来看。
en: Viewed from the angle of real-world pressure.

text: 40岁的男性，通常已经成家立业，他们需要承担更多的家庭责任。
en: The 40-year-old man has usually established his family and career, and needs to bear greater family responsibility.

text: 而40岁的女性，在事业和家庭之间往往需要做出更多的权衡。
en: The 40-year-old woman, between career and family, often needs to make more trade-offs.

text: 双方在面对现实压力时，往往会因为各种原因而失去对彼此的兴趣。
en: When facing real-world pressure, the two sides often lose interest in each other for various reasons.

text: 在现实生活中，男女双方在年龄、生活、情感投入和现实压力等方面往往存在较大的差异。
en: In real life, men and women often differ greatly in age, lifestyle, emotional investment and real-world pressure.

text: 这种差异使得40岁的男性普遍不考虑40岁的女生。
en: Such differences lead 40-year-old men generally not to consider 40-year-old women.

text: 当然，这并不代表40岁的女性就没有机会去爱和被爱。
en: Of course, this does not mean 40-year-old women have no chance to love and be loved.

text: 关键是要找到适合自己，彼此相爱的人，才能在人生的道路上走得更远。
en: The key is to find a person suited to oneself, whom one loves mutually, so as to go further on the road of life.

text: 这种现象可能存在以下一些原因，但并非绝对，也不能一概而论：
en: This phenomenon may exist for the following reasons, but it is not absolute, nor can it be generalised:

text: 1. 传统观念影响：一些传统观念认为男性应该找比自己年轻的女性，这种观念可能在部分人心中依然有一定影响。
en: 1. Influence of traditional conceptions: some traditional notions hold that men should find women younger than themselves, and such notions may still hold some sway in some people's hearts.

text: 2. 生育因素：40 岁女性的生育能力相对下降，可能让一些男性在考虑长期关系时有所顾虑。
en: 2. Fertility factors: a 40-year-old woman's fertility declines relatively, which may give some men pause when considering a long-term relationship.

text: 3. 外貌和精力：一般来说，随着年龄增长，女性在外貌和精力上可能相对不如年轻女性，这可能会影响部分男性的选择。
en: 3. Appearance and energy: generally speaking, with increasing age, women may be relatively lacking compared with younger women in appearance and energy, which may affect some men's choices.

text: 4. 心理预期差异：40 岁的男性可能在心理上对伴侣有不同的期望和需求，与 40 岁女性的期望不一定完全匹配。
en: 4. Differences in psychological expectations: the 40-year-old man may have different psychological expectations and needs of a partner, which do not necessarily fully match those of the 40-year-old woman.

text: 然而，每个人的价值观和偏好都是不同的，也有很多 40 岁的男性会欣赏和选择 40 岁的女性，重要的是建立在真正的了解、尊重和感情基础之上。
en: However, everyone's values and preferences differ, and many 40-year-old men do appreciate and choose 40-year-old women; what matters is building on a genuine foundation of understanding, respect and affection.

text: 感情是非常个体化的，不能简单地用年龄来划分和判断。
en: Romantic feeling is highly individualised and cannot be simply divided and judged by age.
